title: Compatibility of a descended morphism with its descent datum
statement: Let a:X→S and r:X′→X be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with r a singleton fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let F:DD(a)→DD(r≫a) [def-galois-scheme-descent-data-category] and q_A exhibit cartesian squares [def-pc-fibre-product] and base change of the data [def-pd-descent-datum]. For A,B, β:F(A)→F(B) and any X-morphism α:A.V→B.V satisfying q_A≫α.left=β.hom.left≫q_B, α commutes with transport for every test scheme, pair f₀,f₁ with equal images in S, and point z of A over f₀.

proof.text: Over X×_S X the two sides of the required compatibility are morphisms between the corresponding pullbacks. After refinement to X′×_S X′, base-change and reconstruction identify their pullbacks with β’s compatibility equation.

Factor this refinement into two base changes of r. Both are fpqc. Apply the injectivity of morphism descent first to one cover and then to the other to reflect equality. Evaluation at points yields transport compatibility.

lean.statement: theorem fpqc_descent_morphism_compatibility {S X X' : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ S) (r : X' ⟶ X) (hr : Presieve.singleton r ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage X) (F : Over.DescentDataCategory a ⥤ Over.DescentDataCategory (r ≫ a)) (q : ∀ A : Over.DescentDataCategory a, (F.obj A).V.left ⟶ A.V.left) (hq : ∀ A, ∃ hq : q A ≫ A.V.hom = (F.obj A).V.hom ≫ r, IsPullback (q A) (F.obj A).V.hom A.V.hom r ∧ Over.DescentDatum.IsBaseChange rfl hq A.datum (F.obj A).datum) (A B : Over.DescentDataCategory a) (β : F.obj A ⟶ F.obj B) (α : A.V ⟶ B.V) (hα : q A ≫ α.left = β.hom.left ≫ q B) : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₀ f₁ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₀ ≫ a = f₁ ≫ a) (z : Over.mk f₀ ⟶ A.V), B.datum.transport f₀ f₁ h (z ≫ α) = A.datum.transport f₀ f₁ h z ≫ α
